name: ScoutForge

sources.title: Homepage — 'Listing is free and gets you a score'; credit-based human testing exchange
Submit Your App — registration page (sign-in required; form behind account)
Review rules — reviews publish instantly, developer cannot edit/delay/remove, paid reviews labelled
How we score — Scout score methodology

requirements: Web or mobile app — the platform reviews 'emerging web and mobile applications'
Sign-in / account required to reach the app registration form
Free listing automatically receives a 'Scout score'; a human test/review requires credits
Credits are earned by testing other members' apps (~30 min each) or bought/spent via the Promotion Store
preparation: App name, URL, description, category (Productivity, Development & Engineering, Design & Creativity, Social & Community, etc.)
Decide whether to only list (free score) or also request human tests (credits or paid promotion)
workflow: Register the app — listing is free and immediately gets a Scout score
Optionally open a test request: a member tries the app for ~30 minutes and writes what they found
Earn credits by testing other apps (or use the Promotion Store) to fund the request
Listing appears under 'Recently published'; tested apps move to 'Recently tested' with a public written review
watchFor: Reviews go live instantly on submission and CANNOT be edited, delayed, or taken down by the developer — even negative ones; this is stated policy
Developer-funded reviews are publicly labelled as paid
A developer can dispute a reviewer's payment — the dispute reason is shown publicly on the page
The app-register form itself is behind auth — exact fields are not publicly visible
Promotion Store offers paid featuring; featured cards are marked 'Featured'
countsAsLive: App appears in Scout Forge's 'Recently published' / apps listing with a visible Scout score and a public app page
unknowns: Exact fields on the authenticated app registration form
